accounts_get.rationale: Governed: Read account metadata; explicit account required by deployment policy.

dns_records_create.rationale: Governed: Create a single DNS record, affecting traffic or domain verification.

dns_records_delete.rationale: Governed: Delete a single DNS record by explicit zone and record ID; verify record identity before approval.

dns_records_edit.rationale: Governed: PATCH a DNS record; omitted fields may retain existing values.

dns_records_get.rationale: Governed: Read a single DNS record; content may include sensitive verification values.

dns_records_list.rationale: Governed: Read records in an explicit zone; query filters and pagination affect visibility.

dns_records_update.rationale: Governed: PUT a DNS record; review full replacement rather than assuming PATCH semantics.

pages_create.rationale: Governed: Create a Pages project; build commands, source integration and deployment configuration can enable executable automation.

pages_delete.rationale: Governed: Delete a project and its deployments.

pages_deployments_create.rationale: Governed: Create a Git-branch or direct-manifest deployment; branch uses HEAD, not necessarily commit_hash as a pinned revision. Body may contain executable Worker content.

pages_deployments_delete.rationale: Governed: Delete a deployment, potentially affecting available rollback targets.

pages_deployments_get.rationale: Governed: Read deployment status/configuration; results may contain project environment metadata.

pages_deployments_list.rationale: Governed: Read deployment history and configuration metadata.

pages_deployments_retry.rationale: Governed: Retry a deployment; executes build/deploy automation again.

pages_deployments_rollback.rationale: Governed: Change production to a previous deployment.

pages_domains_create.rationale: Governed: Attach a custom hostname to a Pages project.

pages_domains_delete.rationale: Governed: Remove a custom hostname from a Pages project.

pages_domains_get.rationale: Governed: Read domain configuration and validation status.

pages_domains_list.rationale: Governed: List custom domains for an explicit project.

pages_domains_validation_retry.rationale: Governed: Retry domain validation; an operational action, not a pure getter.

pages_edit.rationale: Governed: Change build/source/deployment settings; setting an environment variable key to null deletes it.

pages_get.rationale: Governed: Read project configuration; environment values may be sensitive, so retain governance.

pages_list.rationale: Governed: List projects and configuration in an explicit account; retain governance for sensitive metadata.

pages_source_connect.rationale: Governed: Connect a preauthorized Git provider repository and configure automatic deployments and PR comments.

pages_source_disconnect.rationale: Governed: Disconnect the repository and stop Git-based deployment integration.

zones_get.rationale: Governed: Read metadata of an explicit zone. Zone creation, deletion and global settings are excluded.
